name: How to Clean Refinished Hardwood in Redmond Without Voiding the Warranty
title-tag: How to Clean Refinished Hardwood Floors: Redmond, WA Guide
meta-description: What actually voids a refinishing warranty: steam, vinegar, oil soaps, and polish. A Redmond contractor’s safe cleaning routine for waterborne finishes.
post-summary: November 4, 2026 · Steam mops, vinegar, oil soaps, and acrylic “polish” cause most of the damaged-finish calls we get — and none of it is warranty-covered. The safe routine is a dry microfiber mop and a pH-neutral cleaner, ten minutes a week. Here’s the full rulebook, including the first-week cure schedule.
